chat.prompt:
Daily Mu2e DocDB digest for {date}.

Find the DocDB documents added or updated in the last 24 hours with the kb tools: kb_search with search_filter on source_id mu2e-docdb and a range on insert_time (and update_time) from 24 hours before {time} on. If the range filter returns nothing, say so and say what you tried; do not fill the digest with older documents.

Write the digest: one entry per document with its DocDB number, title, authors if given, and two or three sentences on what it says and why it matters; group the entries by subsystem or topic (tracker, calorimeter, CRV, DAQ, computing, physics, operations, ...). Start with three lines on the most important items of the day.
